findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 23 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 71 questions numbered 1-71; by section: 23.1 8, 23.2 7, 23.3 18, 23.4 10, 23.5 10, 23.6 7, 23.7 6, 23.8 2, 23.9 3.

Covers sections 23.1-23.9 in order; comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small numericals (pKa/Ka, mole ratios, oxidation numbers) were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed (ethanal from ethanol, methanal/formalin, 2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile, 2,4-DNPH and its hydrazone, sodium ethanoate from propanone, ethanol oxidised to ethanal before iodoform, CH₃COOH + NaHCO₃, delocalisation over -COO⁻, +I of CH₃, ethyl ethanoate more volatile; the '14 days' figure is not used).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
